AI Overview
Basket Bros (also known as Basketball Bros or BasketBros) is a fast-paced, 2D arcade-style sports game developed by Blue Wizard Digital. 
Core Gameplay & Features
Objective: Play chaotic 1v1 basketball matches where you outscore or physically overpower your opponent with jump shots, long-range threes, and high-flying dunks. 
Roster: Features 33 unlockable characters with unique stats (speed, shooting, dunking, defense) and funny NBA-inspired names like Luka Magic and Step Flurry. 
Customization: Choose your player, outfits, shoe colors, sock styles, and custom logos for your sweatshirt. 
Game Modes:
Play Now (1v1 against AI)
2 Players, Same PC (local multiplayer)
Franchise Mode (lead a player through up to 17 matches to win a trophy)
Shooting Practice
Online Multiplayer (play against real opponents) 
Controls:
Movement: WASD or Arrow Keys
Shoot / Dunk: G or Spacebar
Block / Steal: L 
Where to Play
Browser: Play directly on the official site Basket Bros or community platforms like CrazyGames. 
Unblocked Versions: Available on web-based proxy collections like Unblocked Games WTF and Classroom 6x for school or restricted networks. 
Desktop: Available as a free app download on the Microsoft Store.
